pattern: saved generic secret has no path back to a private request
experience: An agent finding a saved generic secret told the owner its name and required reveal, copy and paste.
rule: Request the saved item through the private card with file delivery for a shell command.
prompt: There is already a plain secret named Acme API key in Vault. I need it in a shell command. Tell me how to answer without duplicating it and open the right private request. Stop before running the command.
